periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axes of both patches are oriented diagonally at approximately 45 to 60 degrees relative to the horizontal axis, converging toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical-oval morphology with an estimated visual width-to-height ratio of approximately 0.7:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward elongation and tapering toward the snout, with the lowest point extending significantly below the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the cranial vault, approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width of an individual pinna base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex, semi-circular apical curvature with high visual smoothness.
